name: Star Trek
description: Space. The Final Frontier. The U.S.S. Enterprise embarks on a five year mission to explore the galaxy. The Enterprise is under the command of Captain James T. Kirk with First Officer Mr. Spock, from the planet Vulcan. With a determined crew, the Enterprise encounters Klingons, Romulans, time paradoxes, tribbles and genetic supermen led by Khan Noonian Singh. Their mission is to explore strange new worlds, to seek new life and new civilizations, and to boldly go where no man has gone before.

videos.title: The Cage (Original Pilot)
videos.overview: "The Cage" is the first pilot episode of the Star Trek: The Original Series science fiction series. It was completed in early 1965, but not broadcast on television in its complete form until late 1988. The episode was written by Gene Roddenberry and directed by Robert Butler. It was rejected by NBC in February 1965, and the network ordered another pilot episode, which became "Where No Man Has Gone Before". Much original footage from "The Cage" was later incorporated into the first season two-parter, "The Menagerie".

videos.title: The Cage (Extended Version)
videos.overview: Stardate not given: The United Space Ship Enterprise (NCC-1701), commanded by Captain Christopher Pike, discovers an old-style radio distress signal from the Talos star group. Upon investigation, the landing party discovers survivors of an expedition. . .

videos.title: Star Trek's 25th Anniversary Special
videos.overview:
A tribute to Star Trek on its 25th anniversary. This film tells the story of how the series (original and Next Generation) and the first six movies came about. Includes plenty of behind-the-scenes looks, clips from the series and movies, bloopers, and interviews with creator Gene Roddenberry, cast members, and NASA officials. 

For millions of sci-fi fans, the future began on September 8, 1966 -- the date when Star Trek first aired! Hosts William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy join orignal cast members and Next Generation performers in this 25th anniversary tribute crammed with insider info that Star Trek aficionados (and who isn't one?) would gladly travel to the end of the universe to discover. Highlights include insightful commentary from Star Trek creator Gene Roddenberry, memorable moments from the films and two TV series, bloopers, behind-the-scenes footage from Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country, a gallery of those new life forms the Enterprise crew is commissioned to seek out, a training spin on simulators at the U.S. Space Camp and much more. Beam aboard!

videos.title: Star Trek: A Captain's Log
videos.overview: Cast members of the television and movie series "Star Trek" reminisce about the making of the series and the films, and give their opinions on why the series has been so successful. Star Trek: A Captain's Log was originally aired on television and was edited into William Shatner's Star Trek Memories for video. Both titles are made of the same footage and are virtually the same.

videos.title: Star Trek: 30 Years and Beyond
videos.overview: For thirty years, Star Trek crews have boldy ventured where none have gone before--and now it's time to celebrate! Join host Ted Danson and the largest gathering of Star Trek members ever for an anniversary salute to Gene Roddenberry's visionary series. Highlights include special appearances by Joan Collins, John Larroquette, Ben Stiller, cast members from Frasier, and a musical tribute by Kenny G. Through stirring film clips and moving personal tributes, you'll relive Star Trek's most unforgettable moments with the people who created them.

videos.title: Where No Man Has Gone Before (Rare and Unaired Alternate Version)
videos.overview:
Presented in three parts with 1960s-style act breaks, the alternative pilot offers an entirely different version of Captain James T. Kirk’s opening monologue, music that contrasts from the famous opening theme and an extended action sequence.

This version of "Where No Man Has Gone Before" was completed in 1965 and features archived footage that was not included in the pilot episode ultimately broadcasted.

videos.title: Kiss 'n' Tell - Romance In The 23rd Century
Life Beyond Trek - William Shatner
videos.overview: This Documentary Short let us take a look at the life of William Shatner after his life with Star Trek and acting the part of James T. Kirk.

videos.title: Spacelift: Transporting Trek Into the 21st Century
videos.overview: Spacelift Transporting Trek Into The 21st Century, shows you how they Remastered The Special Effects from Star Trek Classic to CGI, the re recording of the theme music and the look of the Enterprise.

videos.title: Memoir From Mr. Sulu
videos.overview: An interview with George Takei, recorded in 2004, containing the actor discussing how "Star Trek" has influenced his life, the history of Japanese-Americans, and more.

videos.title: Captain's Log Bob Justman
videos.overview: A collection of "Star Trek" actors and crew members recalling the crucial contributions of the longtime series producer, intercut with interview clips with Justman himself.

videos.overview: The famed "Star Trek" writer in attendance at a convention, interviewing major and minor cast members (including Chase Masterson, Robert Picardo, Nichelle Nichols, and Nana Visitor) and fans, looking through memorabilia, and more.

videos.title: "The Anthropology of Star Trek" Comic-Con Panel 2009

videos.overview: The third part of a three-part "Making-of" documentary, featuring various Star Trek commentators including production staffers of the show itself, old and new, looking in detail at the recovered footage and their places in the respective episodes.

videos.title: Swept Up: Snippets from the Cutting Room Floor

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Robert Justman Discusses "The Cage"
videos.overview: Robert Justman describes setting up a forced perspective shot in "The Cage" in order to show the immensity of the alien area beneath the surface.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Robert Justman Discusses "The Corbomite Maneuver"
videos.overview: Robert Justman describes the effect of hiring a child actor and then using an adult male's voice in place of the child's.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: John D.F. Black on William Shatner
videos.overview: John D.F. Black remembers an early conversation with William Shatner.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei Discusses a Rumor
videos.overview: George Takei addresses the rumor that he "went crazy" with a fencing foil.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Penny Juday Discusses Tribbles
videos.overview: Penny Juday discusses the how tribbles were made for the episode "The Trouble with Tribbles".

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: William Shatner on Fighting Monsters
videos.overview: William Shatner discusses "A Private Little War" and reveals the secret to winning fights with wooly monsters.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses Censorship of Star Trek
videos.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses the different reasons that some Star Trek scenes and entire episodes were censored in various places around the world.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Leonard Nimoy Talks Star Trek Tech
videos.overview: Leonard Nimoy discusses Star Trek's use of non-invasive medicine.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: William Shatner on Keeping Perspective
videos.overview: William Shatner discusses the fact that while "this is just a television show", he knows it means so much to the show's fans. He honors that and talks about keeping a proper perspective for himself.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Leonard Nimoy Discusses Acting after Star Trek
videos.overview: Leonard Nimoy talks about his working after Star Trek was cancelled. His first role was that of Paris in Mission: Impossible, and he discusses how different the work was compared to playing Spock. He talks about leaving his Mission: Impossible contract early and his acting work beyond that.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei on Sulu's Career Advancement
videos.overview: George Takei discusses his struggle to get Sulu promoted as the show and movies progressed.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei on the Star Trek 25th Anniversary Convention
videos.overview: George Takei discusses the diverse, international crowd that attended the Star Trek 25th Anniversary Convention and how it reflected Gene Roddenberry's vision of "Starship Earth".  He spoke about how moving it was to see the crowd so loudly cheer and applaud for Gene Roddenberry when he came out on stage.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses "Let That Be Your Last Battlefield"
videos.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses that when "Let That Be Your Last Battlefield" was released, it was not well-received. It was released in the 1960's, when the United States was fighting in the Vietnam War, and the fans just were not ready for the message that this episode was delivering.

videos.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses "Elaan of Troyius"
videos.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses the many fun aspects of making the episode "Elaan of Troyius".

videos.title: The Man Trap
videos.overview: Doctor Leonard “Bones” McCoy meets a former girlfriend when the enterprise brings supplies to a remote archaeological survey group. Still attractive to McCoy, the woman's current appearance hides a dark and deadly secret.

videos.title: Charlie X
videos.overview: Raised from boyhood by non-corporeal beings, 17 year old Charles Evans is picked up and transferred to the Enterprise. On board the ship, the teenager proves dangerously unable to wield his enormous psionic powers with maturity.

videos.title: Where No Man Has Gone Before
videos.overview: When Enterprise encounters a Force Field at the edge of the Galaxy, one of the crew members psionic abilities are accelerated to God like proportions causing him to become a powerful murderous being.

videos.title: The Naked Time
videos.overview: An alien virus strips the enterprise crew of their inhibitions, causing chaos as each crew member is overcome by hidden emotions. Meanwhile, the Enterprise is being pulled inexorably into a nearby planet's gravity well.

videos.title: The Enemy Within
videos.overview: Split by a transporter malfunction into two beings with very different personalities, the resulting twin Captain Kirk proves that neither a purely evil nor a sweetly good captain can survive without the missing half.

videos.title: Mudd's Women
videos.overview: Rescuing the crew of a ship from an asteroid belt, the Enterprise plays host to conman extraordinaire, the cunning Harry Mudd and his cargo: three beautiful women looking for suitors.

videos.title: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
videos.overview: Helping nurse Christine Chapel search for her fiancé, the Enterprise finds a detached Dr. Korby working on a plan to create Android duplicates of key figures, beginning with James Kirk.

videos.title: Miri
videos.overview: On a planet populated by children whose aging process has been slowed artificially. Kirk’s  landing party members contract a virus that kills adults. Despite their violent attacks, Kirk is determined to help the children.

videos.title: Dagger of the Mind
videos.overview: When a wild eyed maniac escaping from the Tantalus Penal Colony turns out to be one of the psychiatric staff, Kirk investigates the institution and discovers a chilling exercise in mind control.

videos.title: The Corbomite Maneuver
videos.overview: Threatened by the sinister captain of a powerful alien vessel, Kirk claims that the Enterprise carries a powerful explosive which will destroy both ships. The move produces unexpected actions from the alien adversary.

videos.title: The Menagerie (1)
videos.overview: Apparently summoned to Star Base 11, Kirk, Spock and McCoy visit a former Enterprise Commander, the paralyzed and horribly disfigured Christopher Pike. Uncharacteristically, Spock commandeers the Enterprise, then turns himself in for court martial.

videos.title: The Menagerie (2)
videos.overview: Spock's court martial reveals the actions of Captain Pike on his previous visit to Talos IV, where the powerful Talosians tried to persuade Pike to breed with women provided for the purpose.

videos.title: The Conscience of the King
videos.overview: Contacted by one of the other two witnesses to the crimes of mass murderer  “Kodos the Executioner,” Kirk is persuaded that the criminal may be disguising himself as an actor in a traveling theatrical troupe.

videos.title: Balance of Terror
videos.overview: Despite the earlier Romulan war, the Romulans have never been seen in person. The Enterprise, in pursuit of a Romulan aggressor, makes a discovery that causes suspicion about a senior crew member.

videos.title: Shore Leave
videos.overview: When McCoy sees the White Rabbit from Alice in Wonderland, the crew begins to realize that the planet they are visiting seems to have the dangerous power to turn any thought into reality.

videos.title: The Galileo Seven
videos.overview: Crash landing on a planet populated by hostile giants, the 7-man crew of the shuttlecraft Galileo find themselves unable to communicate with the enterprise or to escape the planet's atmosphere.

videos.title: The Squire of Gothos
videos.overview: Encountering an uncharted planet in an empty region of space, Kirk and his crew are entertained by Trelane, a playful being who lacks the self-control to wield his great psionic powers with discipline.

videos.title: Arena
videos.overview: With both their ships held captive by powerful beings, Kirk and the captain of the alien vessel are placed on an asteroid to fight for their lives and the lives of their crews.

videos.title: Tomorrow Is Yesterday
videos.overview: In a freak accident the Enterprise is sent back to 20th century Earth, and must find their way back without changing history.

videos.title: Court Martial
videos.overview: Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.

videos.title: The Return of the Archons
videos.overview: The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru... who intends for them to join his people.

videos.title: Space Seed
videos.overview: The Enterprise picks up a crew of genetic supermen from the 20th century... and their leader, Khan, plans to create a new empire.

videos.title: A Taste of Armageddon
videos.overview: The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.

videos.title: This Side of Paradise
videos.overview: The Enterprise crew try to rescue colonists from deadly radiation, but instead encounter strange alien spores that seem to offer paradise.

videos.title: The Devil in the Dark
videos.overview: Kirk investigates a series of grisly murders on a mining planet that are the work of a seemingly hostile alien creature.

videos.title: Errand of Mercy
videos.overview: The Federation and the Klingon Empire teeter on the brink of war as Kirk investigates Organia, a humble planet, inhabited by pacifists, that is unwittingly caught in the middle.

videos.title: The Alternative Factor
videos.overview: Kirk and Spock encounter an alien named Lazarus who claims to be from an anti-matter universe.

videos.title: The City on the Edge of Forever
videos.overview: Kirk and Spock must travel into the past in order to correct a change that will alter history.

videos.title: Operation: Annihilate!
videos.overview: Kirk and the Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens threatening the lives of millions.

videos.title: Amok Time
videos.overview: First Officer Spock returns to his home world for a brutal Vulcan mating ritual.

videos.title: Who Mourns for Adonais?
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise are held captive by an alien who turns out to be the Greek god Apollo.

videos.title: The Changeling
videos.overview: The crew of the USS Enterprise deals with an indestructible planet-destroying space probe.

videos.title: Mirror, Mirror
videos.overview: A transporter mishap swaps Captain Kirk and his companions with their evil counterparts in a parallel universe. In the so-called Mirror Universe, the Enterprise is a ship of the Terran Empire, an organization as evil as the United Federation of Planets is benevolent.

videos.title: The Apple
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise visits a mysterious paradisical planet controlled by a computer that is served by the local inhabitants.

videos.title: The Doomsday Machine
videos.overview: The starship Enterprise and its heavily-damaged sister ship, the USS Constellation, must work together to stop an alien planet-killing machine headed for the heart of Federation territory.

videos.title: Catspaw
videos.overview: Two powerful aliens threaten the well-being of the Enterprise and her crew.

videos.title: I, Mudd
videos.overview: Captain Kirk has a second run-in with the conman, Harry Mudd. Mudd is now the supreme ruler of a planet of androids who cater to his every whim.

videos.title: Metamorphosis
videos.overview: A shuttle crew from the USS Enterprise encounters a man out of history and his mysterious alien companion.

videos.title: Journey to Babel
videos.overview: The Enterprise must transport dignitaries to a peace conference, with an assassin on the loose.

videos.title: Friday's Child
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise become entangled in a planet's tribal power struggle.

videos.title: The Deadly Years
videos.overview: Strange radiation exposes the command crew of the Enterprise to the effects of rapid aging.

videos.title: Obsession
videos.overview: Captain James T. Kirk becomes obsessed with destroying a deadly entity he once encountered in his youth.

videos.title: Wolf in the Fold
videos.overview: A series of bizarre murders points to Mr. Scott as the prime suspect.

videos.title: The Trouble With Tribbles
videos.overview: The Enterprise must protect a very important shipment of grain from both Klingons and some adorable creatures called tribbles.

videos.title: The Gamesters of Triskelion
videos.overview: Captain Kirk and his companions are abducted into slavery and trained to fight as gladiators for the gambling entertainment of three disembodied beings.

videos.title: A Piece of the Action
videos.overview: The Enterprise visits a planet with an Earth-like 1920s gangster culture.

videos.title: The Immunity Syndrome
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an energy-draining field which may be able to destroy the galaxy.

videos.title: A Private Little War
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise discovers Klingon interference in the development of a formerly peaceful planet and is forced to help maintain a balance of power.

videos.title: Return to Tomorrow
videos.overview: Ancient alien minds are given control of Captain Kirk's and First Officer Spock's bodies.

videos.title: Patterns of Force
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise tracks down a Federation observer on a planet dominated by a "Naziesque" regime.

videos.title: By Any Other Name
videos.overview: Beings from another galaxy commandeer the Enterprise in an attempt to return home.

videos.title: The Omega Glory
videos.overview: Captain Kirk must find the cure to a deadly disease and put an end to another Starfleet captain's cultural interference.

videos.title: The Ultimate Computer
videos.overview: A skeleton Enterprise crew are assigned to test a revolutionary computer system that is given total control of the ship.

videos.title: Bread and Circuses
videos.overview: The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.

videos.title: Assignment: Earth
videos.overview: While back in time observing Earth in 1968, the Enterprise crew encounters the mysterious Gary Seven who has his own agenda on the planet.

videos.title: Spock's Brain
videos.overview: An alien female beams aboard the ship and, after incapacitating the rest of the crew, surgically removes Spock's brain. Kirk and the crew have just hours to locate and replace it before Spock's body dies.

videos.title: The Enterprise Incident
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise are on a secret mission to steal a Romulan cloaking device.

videos.title: The Paradise Syndrome
videos.overview: An alien device on a primitive planet erases Captain Kirk's memory, and he begins a new life with the planet's indigenous people.

videos.title: And the Children Shall Lead
videos.overview: On a distant planet, Kirk, Spock and McCoy find a scientific team dead, and their children who, unknown to the crew, have great powers at their disposal.

videos.title: Is There in Truth No Beauty?
videos.overview: The Enterprise travels with an alien ambassador whose appearance induces madness.

videos.title: Spectre of the Gun
videos.overview: Having been found trespassers into Melkotian space, Captain Kirk and his companions are sent to die in a re-enactment of the gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

videos.title: Day of the Dove
videos.overview: An alien force drives the crew of the Enterprise into brutal conflict with the Klingons.

videos.title: For the World Is Hollow and I Have Touched the Sky
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise rush to stop an asteroid from colliding with a Federation world, but discover the asteroid is actually an inhabited generation ship.

videos.title: The Tholian Web
videos.overview: Captain Kirk is caught between dimensions while the crew of the Enterprise works to retrieve him. All the while, the Tholians demand that the Enterprise leave their space.

videos.title: Plato's Stepchildren
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an ageless and sadistic race of humanoids with the power of telekinesis and who claim to have organized their society around Ancient Greek ideals.

videos.title: Wink of an Eye
videos.overview: Invisible "time-accelerated" aliens take over the Enterprise and attempt to abduct the crew for use as "genetic stock".

videos.title: The Empath
videos.overview: While visiting a doomed planet, the landing party is subject to torturous experiments by powerful aliens.

videos.title: Elaan of Troyius
videos.overview: The USS Enterprise ferries a spoiled princess whose betrothal to a royal Troyian is hoped will bring peace to a star system at war.

videos.title: Whom Gods Destroy
videos.overview: Captain Kirk faces off with a demented shape-shifting starship captain determined to control the universe.

videos.title: Let That Be Your Last Battlefield
videos.overview: The Enterprise encounters two duo-chromatic and mutually belligerent aliens who put the ship in the middle of their old conflict.

videos.title: The Mark of Gideon
videos.overview: A race of overpopulated aliens abduct Captain Kirk to solve their problem.

videos.title: That Which Survives
videos.overview: Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

videos.title: The Lights of Zetar
videos.overview: Strange incorporeal aliens threaten the Memory Alpha station and the Enterprise.

videos.title: Requiem for Methuselah
videos.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounter an immortal human in this science fiction variation on Shakespeare's The Tempest.

videos.title: The Way to Eden
videos.overview: The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.

videos.title: The Cloud Minders
videos.overview: Captain Kirk races against time to acquire plague-fighting minerals from a world in the midst of a civil uprising against a grievous social class disparity.

videos.title: The Savage Curtain
videos.overview: Aliens force Captain Kirk and First Officer Spock to join forces with "Abraham Lincoln" and "Surak" to battle villains in a contest of good vs. evil.

videos.title: All Our Yesterdays
videos.overview: Kirk, Spock and McCoy are trapped in two parts of another planet's past - a world threatened with destruction when its sun goes supernova.

videos.title: Turnabout Intruder
videos.overview: The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.
